title: 六千万人的侨务读本：理解中国海外侨民
subtitle: 从“侨牌”到 diaspora policy，一组数字背后的政策逻辑与张力
summary: 六千万海外侨胞加四千万归侨侨眷，合计上亿人口散布全球。理解这组数字，是理解一种跨国人口治理的复杂工程。

en.title: China's Sixty Million: A Reader on the Overseas Chinese
en.subtitle: From "qiao card" to diaspora policy — the logic and tension behind a set of numbers
en.summary: Sixty million overseas Chinese plus forty million returned overseas Chinese and relatives add up to a UK-sized population scattered worldwide. Grasping the figure is to grasp a vast project of transnational population governance.

title: 侨批：维系一个离散群体的汇款家书
subtitle: 一张薄薄的信纸，承载着百年海外华侨的家国与生计
summary: 侨批把家书与汇款合二为一，从东南亚寄回闽粤乡村，是早期 diaspora 金融的样本，也是离散群体情感延续的纽带。

en.title: Qiaopi: The Remittance Letters That Sustained a Diaspora
en.subtitle: A thin sheet of paper carrying a century of overseas Chinese livelihood and longing
en.summary: Fusing letter and remittance, the qiaopi carried money and word from Southeast Asia back to Fujian and Guangdong — an early specimen of diaspora finance and the emotional sinew of a scattered people.

title: 越南制造：全球供应链重构下的新机遇
subtitle: 在中美博弈与产业转移的浪潮中，越南如何承接下一波制造红利
summary: 2026 年，越南以 9800 万人口和年轻劳动力，成为全球制造业转移的首选目的地。本文考察其产业基础、外资结构与瓶颈。

en.title: Vietnam Manufacturing: New Opportunities Amid Global Supply-Chain Realignment
en.subtitle: How Vietnam captures the next wave of manufacturing amid US–China rivalry and industrial relocation
en.summary: In 2026, with 98 million people and a young workforce, Vietnam became the top destination for global manufacturing relocation. This piece surveys its industrial base, foreign-capital structure, and bottlenecks.

title: 印尼镍矿出口禁令与全球电动车产业链
subtitle: 从原矿到电池：雅加达的产业升级野心与代价
summary: 印尼握有全球最大镍储量，出口禁令重塑了电动车电池上游格局，但也引发了外资撤离与环保争议。

en.title: Indonesia's Nickel Export Ban and the Global EV Battery Chain
en.subtitle: From raw ore to battery: Jakarta's industrial-upgrading ambition and its costs
en.summary: Holding the world's largest nickel reserves, Indonesia's export ban reshaped the EV battery upstream — yet triggered foreign-capital hesitation and environmental disputes.

title: 湄公河的旱涝：气候变化与地缘博弈
subtitle: 一条跨国河流承载的生态危机与水权之争
summary: 上游筑坝、下游干涸——湄公河的旱涝交替，是气候变暖与水电开发叠加的结果，也是六国博弈的缩影。

en.title: The Mekong's Droughts and Floods: Climate Change and Geopolitics
en.subtitle: A transnational river's ecological crisis and the contest over water rights
en.summary: Upstream dams, downstream dry spells — the Mekong's alternating droughts and floods are the compound result of warming and hydropower, and a mirror of six-nation contention.

title: 新加坡：小国的大外交
subtitle: 在大国之间走钢丝的艺术与边界
summary: 从李光耀到第四代领导层，新加坡用外交杠杆撬动远超其体量的国际影响力，其平衡术如何延续？

en.title: Singapore: A Small State's Big Diplomacy
en.subtitle: The art and limits of walking the tightrope between great powers
en.summary: From Lee Kuan Yew to the fourth-generation leadership, Singapore has leveraged diplomacy to punch far above its weight. How long can the balancing act last?

title: 菲律宾南海政策转向观察
subtitle: 马尼拉在华盛顿与北京之间的钟摆
summary: 从杜特尔特的亲华到小马科斯的回归美菲同盟，菲律宾南海政策的钟摆，折射出东盟在地缘竞争中的两难。

en.title: Watching the Philippines' South China Sea Pivot
en.subtitle: Manila's pendulum between Washington and Beijing
en.summary: From Duterte's tilt toward Beijing to Marcos Jr.'s return to the US alliance, Manila's South China Sea pendulum mirrors ASEAN's dilemma amid geopolitical competition.
